title.zh: 卷八十三 志第三十三: 選舉三
title.raw: 卷八十三 志第三十三: 選舉三 Volume 83 Treatises 36: Selection of Officials 3

sentences.zh: 選舉三 ○銓法中

translations.literal: Selection of Officials 3 ○ Within the Laws on Examination and Appointment
translations.idiomatic: Selection of Officials, Part Three — On the Laws Governing Examination and Appointment

sentences.zh: 至元四年，詔：「諸官品正從分等，職官用蔭，各止一名。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiyuan, an edict: "All official ranks shall be divided by regular and subordinate grades. Office-holding officials who use privilege appointment are limited to one person each."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Zhiyuan era, an imperial edict declared: "Official ranks shall be graded by regular and subordinate status. Each office-holder entitled to privilege appointment may name only one heir."

sentences.zh: 諸蔭官不以居官、去任、致仕、身故，其承蔭之人，年及二十五以上者聽。

translations.literal: For all privilege-appointed officials, whether the ancestor is in office, has left post, has retired, or has died, those who inherit the privilege and are twenty-five years of age or above shall be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Privilege appointment was allowed regardless of whether the ancestor still held office, had left his post, had retired, or was deceased — provided the heir was at least twenty-five years old.

sentences.zh: 諸用蔭者，以嫡長子。

translations.literal: For all who use privilege appointment, the heir-eldest son shall be used.
translations.idiomatic: The heir entitled to privilege appointment was the eldest son of the principal wife.

sentences.zh: 若嫡長子有廢疾，立嫡長子之子孫，曾玄同。

translations.literal: If the heir-eldest son has crippling illness, establish the heir-eldest son's descendants — great-grandsons and the same.
translations.idiomatic: If the eldest son of the principal wife was disabled, his descendants were appointed instead — sons, grandsons, and great-grandsons alike.

sentences.zh: 如無，立嫡長子同母弟，曾玄同。

translations.literal: If none, establish the heir-eldest son's younger brother by the same mother — great-grandsons and the same.
translations.idiomatic: If there were none, the next choice was a younger brother of the eldest son by the same mother, and their descendants in turn.

sentences.zh: 如無，立繼室所生。

translations.literal: If none, establish one born of a successor wife.
translations.idiomatic: If there were none, a son born of a successor wife was appointed.

sentences.zh: 如無，立次室所生。

translations.literal: If none, establish one born of a secondary wife.
translations.idiomatic: If there were none, a son born of a secondary wife was appointed.

sentences.zh: 如無，立婢子。

translations.literal: If none, establish a son born of a bondwoman.
translations.idiomatic: If there were none, a son born of a bondwoman was appointed.

sentences.zh: 如絕嗣者，傍蔭其親兄弟，各及子孫。

translations.literal: If the line dies out, collateral privilege appointment extends to close brothers, each including their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: If the direct line failed, collateral privilege extended to full brothers and their descendants.

sentences.zh: 如無，傍蔭伯叔及其子孫。

translations.literal: If none, collateral privilege appointment extends to paternal uncles and their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: If there were none, it extended to paternal uncles and their descendants.

sentences.zh: 諸用蔭者，孫降子、曾孫降孫、婢生子及傍蔭者，皆於合敘品從降一等。

translations.literal: For all who use privilege appointment: when a grandson inherits as a son, when a great-grandson inherits as a grandson, sons born of bondwomen, and those under collateral privilege — all have one grade reduced from the rank they would otherwise receive.
translations.idiomatic: In every case of privilege appointment — whether a grandson stood in for a son, a great-grandson for a grandson, the heir was a bondwoman's son, or the line was collateral — the appointee received one rank below the grade he would otherwise have earned.

sentences.zh: 諸蔭子入品職，循其資考，流轉升遷。

translations.literal: For all sons entering ranked office by privilege, they follow their qualifications and examinations, rotating and advancing in promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Sons who entered ranked office through privilege were promoted by rotation according to their qualifications and service reviews.

sentences.zh: 廉慎幹濟者，依格超升。

translations.literal: Those who are incorrupt, prudent, and capable shall be promoted beyond the norm according to regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who were incorrupt, careful, and effective could be promoted ahead of schedule under the regulations.

sentences.zh: 特恩擢用者，不拘此例。

translations.literal: Those specially elevated by imperial grace are not bound by this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Those raised by special imperial favor were exempt from this rule.

sentences.zh: 其有不務廉慎，違犯禮法者，依格降罰，重者除名。

translations.literal: Those who do not pursue incorrupt prudence and who violate ritual and law shall be demoted and penalized according to regulations; serious cases shall be struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Those who failed to maintain integrity or who violated ritual and law were demoted and punished under the regulations; in serious cases they were removed from the rolls entirely.

sentences.zh: 諸自九品依例遷至正三品，止於本等流轉，二品以上選自特旨。

translations.literal: For all who are promoted by rule from ninth rank to regular third rank, they circulate only within that grade; selection to second rank and above comes by special imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: An official promoted by rule from ninth rank up to regular third rank could circulate only within that grade; appointment to second rank or above required a special imperial order.

sentences.zh: 諸職官蔭子之後，若有餘子，不得於諸官府自求職事，諸官府亦不許任用。

translations.literal: After an office-holding official's privileged son has been appointed, if there are remaining sons, they may not seek office on their own at any government office, nor may any government office employ them.
translations.idiomatic: Once an office-holder's privileged son had been appointed, any remaining sons were forbidden to seek office on their own, and no government office might employ them.

sentences.zh: 」五年，詔：「諸蔭官各具父祖歷仕緣由、去任身故歲月並所受宣敕劄付、彩畫宗支，指實該承蔭人姓名年甲，本處官司體勘房親，揭照籍冊，別無詐冒，及無廢疾過犯等事，上司審驗相同，保結申覆，令親賫文解赴部。

translations.literal: " In the fifth year, an edict: "Every privilege-appointed official must fully report the reasons for his father and grandfather's successive service, the month and year of leaving office or death, and the proclamation appointment documents and letters received, along with a colored lineage chart. He must identify in fact the name and age of the person who should inherit the privilege. The local office shall investigate among neighbors and kin, consult against the household register, verify there is no fraud or impersonation, and no crippling illness or past offenses, etc. The superior office shall review and confirm agreement, guarantee and submit for verification, and have a kinsman carry the documents of release to the ministry."
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth year, another edict required every privilege appointee to submit a full account of his father and grandfather's successive service, the date of their departure or death, and all proclamation appointment documents received, together with a colored genealogical chart naming the heir's age and identity. The local office was to verify the claim through neighbors and kin, cross-check the household register, and confirm that there was no fraud, disability, or prior offense. After the superior office confirmed the findings and filed a guarantee, a kinsman was to carry the certified documents to the ministry."

sentences.zh: 諸蔭敘人員，除蒙古及已當禿魯花人數別行定奪外，三品以下、七品以上、年二十五之上者，當儤使一年，並不支俸。

translations.literal: For all persons receiving privilege appointment, except Mongols and those who have already served as tulughach — handled separately — those below third rank and seventh rank and above, and twenty-five years of age or above, shall perform one year of corvée rotational service and receive no salary.
translations.idiomatic: Except for Mongols and those who had already performed tulughach guard service — governed by separate rules — privilege appointees below third rank and seventh rank or above, aged twenty-five or older, were required to serve one year of unpaid corvée rotational duty.

sentences.zh: 滿日，三品至五品子孫量材敘用外，六品七品子準上銓註監當差使，已後通驗各界增虧定奪。

translations.literal: Upon completion, except for descendants of third to fifth rank who are appointed according to ability, sons of sixth and seventh rank follow the above for examination and appointment to supervisory and warehouse duty assignments; thereafter the overall gains and losses of each circuit shall be comprehensively verified to determine disposition.
translations.idiomatic: When that year was complete, descendants of third- through fifth-rank officials were appointed according to ability; sons of sixth- and seventh-rank officials were examined and posted to supervisory or warehouse duties as above. Thereafter the net gains and losses of each circuit were reviewed before final disposition.

sentences.zh: 」十六年，部擬：「管匠官止於管匠官內遷用。

translations.literal: " In the sixteenth year, the ministry proposed: "Crafts-supervising officials shall be transferred only among crafts-supervising officials.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixteenth year, the ministry proposed: "Officials who supervised crafts could be transferred only among posts within that same category.

sentences.zh: 其身故匠官之子，若依管民官品級承蔭，緣匠官至正九品以下，止有院長、同院務，例不入流品，似難一例蔭用。

translations.literal: If the son of a deceased crafts official were to inherit privilege according to the rank of civilian-administering officials, since crafts officials only reach regular ninth rank and below, having only institute directors and co-institute managers, by precedent they do not enter the regular ranks — it seems difficult to apply privilege appointment to them by the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: If the son of a deceased crafts official inherited privilege by the standards of civilian administration, the result would be awkward: crafts officials ranked no higher than regular ninth grade and held only such posts as institute director or co-institute manager, which by precedent lay outside the regular ranks. The same privilege rule could hardly be applied to them.

sentences.zh: 比附承蔭例，量擬正從五品子於九品匠官內敘，六品、七品子於院長內敘。

translations.literal: Drawing on the privilege inheritance precedent, it is proposed for consideration that sons of regular and subordinate fifth rank be appointed within ninth-rank crafts officials, and sons of sixth and seventh rank within institute directors.
translations.idiomatic: Drawing on the privilege inheritance precedent, it was proposed that sons of regular and subordinate fifth-rank officials be appointed within ninth-rank crafts posts, and sons of sixth- and seventh-rank officials within institute directorships.

sentences.zh: 凡儤直曾當怯薛身役，已經歷仕及止有一子，五十以上者，並免。

translations.literal: All who during corvée rotation have previously served in keshig personal service, have already held office, have only one son, or are fifty years of age or above — all are exempt.
translations.idiomatic: Exempt from corvée duty were those who had already served in the keshig, those who had already held office, those who had only one son, and those aged fifty or above.

sentences.zh: 」二十七年，詔：「凡軍民官陣亡，軍官襲父職，民官陣亡者，其子比父職降二等敘，其孫若弟復降一等。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-seventh year, an edict: "For all military and civilian officials killed in battle: military officials' sons inherit the father's post. For civilian officials killed in battle, the son is appointed two ranks below the father's office; the grandson or younger brother is reduced one rank further."
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-seventh year, an edict ruled that when military or civilian officials fell in battle, a military officer's son inherited his father's post outright. If a civilian official was killed, his son was appointed two ranks below the father's office, and a grandson or younger brother one rank lower still."

sentences.zh: 」大德四年，省議：「諸職官子孫蔭敘，正一品子，正五品敘。

translations.literal: " In the fourth year of Dade, the provincial administration council deliberated: "For all office-holding officials' descendants receiving privilege appointment: a regular first-rank official's son receives appointment at regular fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth year of the Dade era, the provincial council fixed the privilege appointment grades: the son of a regular first-rank official was appointed at regular fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 從一品子，從五品敘。

translations.literal: A subordinate first-rank official's son receives appointment at subordinate fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a subordinate first-rank official was appointed at subordinate fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 正二品子，正六品敘。

translations.literal: A regular second-rank official's son receives appointment at regular sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a regular second-rank official was appointed at regular sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 從二品子，從六品敘。

translations.literal: A subordinate second-rank official's son receives appointment at subordinate sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a subordinate second-rank official was appointed at subordinate sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 正三品子，正七品敘。

translations.literal: A regular third-rank official's son receives appointment at regular seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a regular third-rank official was appointed at regular seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 從三品子，從七品敘。

translations.literal: A subordinate third-rank official's son receives appointment at subordinate seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a subordinate third-rank official was appointed at subordinate seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 正四品子，正八品敘。

translations.literal: A regular fourth-rank official's son receives appointment at regular eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a regular fourth-rank official was appointed at regular eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 從四品子，從八品敘。

translations.literal: A subordinate fourth-rank official's son receives appointment at subordinate eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a subordinate fourth-rank official was appointed at subordinate eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 正五品子，正九品敘。

translations.literal: A regular fifth-rank official's son receives appointment at regular ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a regular fifth-rank official was appointed at regular ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 從五品子，從九品敘。

translations.literal: A subordinate fifth-rank official's son receives appointment at subordinate ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a subordinate fifth-rank official was appointed at subordinate ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 正六品子，

translations.literal: A regular sixth-rank official's son,
translations.idiomatic: The son of a regular sixth-rank official —

sentences.zh: （流官於巡檢內用，雜職於省劄錢谷官內用。）〉

translations.literal: (For regular officials, appoint within patrol inspectors; for miscellaneous officials, appoint within provincial-notification revenue and grain officials.)
translations.idiomatic: (regular officials were placed among patrol inspectors; miscellaneous officials among revenue and grain posts under provincial notification.)

sentences.zh: 從六品子，近上錢谷官。

translations.literal: A subordinate sixth-rank official's son — a higher-grade revenue and grain official.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a subordinate sixth-rank official received a higher-grade revenue and grain post.

sentences.zh: 正七品子，酌中錢谷官。

translations.literal: A regular seventh-rank official's son — a middle-grade revenue and grain official.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a regular seventh-rank official received a middle-grade revenue and grain post.

sentences.zh: 從七品子，近下錢谷官。

translations.literal: A subordinate seventh-rank official's son — a lower-grade revenue and grain official.
translations.idiomatic: The son of a subordinate seventh-rank official received a lower-grade revenue and grain post.

sentences.zh: 諸色目人比漢人優一等蔭敘，達魯花赤子孫與民官子孫一體蔭敘，傍蔭照例降敘。

translations.literal: All Semu people receive privilege appointment one grade higher than Han Chinese. Darughachi sons and grandsons receive privilege appointment on the same terms as civilian officials' descendants. Collateral privilege follows precedent with reduced appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Semu people received privilege appointment one grade higher than Han Chinese. Sons and grandsons of darughachi were treated like the descendants of civilian officials. Collateral heirs were appointed at reduced grades according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 」至大四年，詔：「諸職官子孫承蔭，須試一經一史，能通大義者免儤使，不通者發還習學，蒙古、色目願試者聽，仍量進一階。

translations.literal: " In the fourth year of Zhida, an edict: "All office-holding officials' descendants inheriting privilege must be examined in one Classic and one History. Those who comprehend the main principles are exempt from corvée service; those who do not are sent back to study. Mongols and Semu who wish to be examined are permitted, and are still advanced one grade as measured."
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth year of the Zhida era, an edict required descendants inheriting privilege to pass an examination in one Classic and one History. Those who showed mastery of the main ideas were exempt from corvée duty; those who failed were sent back to study. Mongols and Semu who chose to be examined were allowed to do so and could still receive a measured advance of one grade."

sentences.zh: 」延祐六年，部呈：「福建、兩廣、海北、海南、左右兩江、雲南、四川、甘肅等處蔭敘之人，如父祖始仕本處，止以本地方敘用。

translations.literal: " In the sixth year of Yanyou, the ministry submitted: "For persons receiving privilege appointment in Fujian, the Two Guangs, Haibei, Hainan, the Left and Right Two Rivers, Yunnan, Sichuan, Gansu, and other places — if the father and grandfather first took office in that locality, appointment is only within that local region.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth year of the Yanyou era, the ministry reported that in Fujian, the Two Guangs, Haibei, Hainan, the Left and Right Two Rivers, Yunnan, Sichuan, Gansu, and similar regions, privilege appointees whose fathers and grandfathers had first entered service locally were to be posted only within that region.

sentences.zh: 據腹裏、江南歷仕升等遷往者，其子孫弟侄承蔭，又註遠方，誠可憐憫。

translations.literal: According to cases where officials from the interior and Jiangnan served and were promoted and transferred outward, when their sons, grandsons, younger brothers, and nephews inherit privilege they are again posted to distant regions — truly a matter deserving pity.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when officials from the metropolitan interior or Jiangnan had risen in rank and been transferred to distant posts, their sons, grandsons, brothers, and nephews who inherited privilege were often sent still farther away — a hardship that plainly deserved relief.

sentences.zh: 今將承蔭人等量擬敘用，福建、兩廣、八番官員擬江南蔭敘，海北、海南、左右兩江官員擬接連蔭敘，雲南官員擬四川蔭敘，四川、甘肅官員擬陜西蔭敘。」

translations.literal: Now for persons inheriting privilege, proposed appointments: Fujian and Two Guangs officials and officials of the Eight Fan groups — proposed Jiangnan privilege appointment; Haibei, Hainan, and Left and Right Two Rivers officials — proposed adjacent-region privilege appointment; Yunnan officials — proposed Sichuan privilege appointment; Sichuan and Gansu officials — proposed Shaanxi privilege appointment."
translations.idiomatic: The ministry therefore proposed these regional equivalencies for privilege appointment: Fujian, the Two Guangs, and Eight Fan officials would follow Jiangnan standards; Haibei, Hainan, and the Left and Right Two Rivers would follow adjacent-region standards; Yunnan would follow Sichuan; and Sichuan and Gansu would follow Shaanxi."

sentences.zh: 凡遷調閩廣、川蜀、雲南官員：每三歲，遣使與行省銓註，而以監察御史往蒞之。

translations.literal: As for the transfer and reassignment of officials in Min-Guang, Chuan-Shu, and Yunnan: every three years, an envoy is dispatched together with the Branch Secretariat for examination and appointment, and a supervising censor is sent to preside.
translations.idiomatic: For officials transferred among Fujian-Guangdong, Sichuan-Shu, and Yunnan, an envoy was sent every three years to conduct examinations and appointments jointly with the Branch Secretariat, with a supervising censor present to oversee the process.

sentences.zh: 至元十九年，省議：「江淮州郡遠近險易不同，似難一體，今量分為三等，若腹裏常調官員遷入兩廣、福建溪洞州郡者，於本等資歷上，例升二等，其餘州郡，例升一等。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, the provincial council deliberated: "The Jiang-Huai prefectures and districts differ in distance and in difficulty of terrain — it seems hard to treat them uniformly. Now they are measured and divided into three grades. If regularly reassigned officials from the interior are transferred into the Two Guangs and Fujian stream-cave prefectures and districts, on top of their current qualifications they are promoted two grades by rule; for other prefectures and districts, one grade by rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, the provincial council observed that Jiang-Huai prefectures and districts varied too greatly in distance and terrain to be treated alike. They were therefore divided into three grades. Officials regularly transferred from the interior into stream-cave prefectures of the Two Guangs and Fujian received a two-grade promotion on top of their existing qualifications; in other prefectures and districts, one grade.

sentences.zh: 福建、兩廣官員五品以上，照勘員闕，移咨都省銓註，六品以下，就便委用，開具咨省。

translations.literal: For Fujian and Two Guangs officials of fifth rank and above, upon surveying vacancies, a communication is sent to the central secretariat for examination and appointment; for sixth rank and below, they are appointed on the spot and a report is filed with the province.
translations.idiomatic: In Fujian and the Two Guangs, vacancies for fifth rank and above were reported to the central secretariat for examination and appointment; for sixth rank and below, officials were appointed locally and the province was notified.

sentences.zh: 」二十年，部擬：「遷敘江淮官員，擬定應得資品，若於接連福建、兩廣溪洞州郡任用，升一等。

translations.literal: " In the twentieth year, the ministry proposed: "For transferred officials from Jiang-Huai, the qualifications they should receive are determined. If appointed in adjacent Fujian and Two Guangs stream-cave prefectures and districts, one grade promotion.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twentieth year, the ministry proposed that when Jiang-Huai officials were transferred, their due qualifications would be fixed in advance; if they were posted to adjacent stream-cave prefectures in Fujian or the Two Guangs, they would receive one additional grade.

sentences.zh: 甘肅、中興行省所轄系西夏邊地，除本處籍貫見任官外，腹裏遷去甘肅者，擬升二等，中興府擬升一等。

translations.literal: Gansu and the Zhongxing Branch Secretariat jurisdiction border the Western Xia frontier. Except for incumbent officials native to those places, those transferred from the interior to Gansu are proposed for two-grade promotion; to Zhongxing Prefecture, one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu and the territory under the Zhongxing Branch Secretariat lay on the former Western Xia frontier. Except for native incumbents, officials transferred from the interior to Gansu were proposed for a two-grade promotion, and to Zhongxing Prefecture for one grade.

sentences.zh: 」二十二年，詔：「管民官腹裏遷去四川升一等，接連溪洞升二等。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-second year, an edict: "Civilian-administering officials transferred from the interior to Sichuan — one grade promotion; to adjacent stream-cave regions — two grades.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-second year, an edict ruled that civilian-administering officials transferred from the interior to Sichuan received one grade of promotion, and those sent to adjacent stream-cave regions received two.

sentences.zh: 四川見任官遷往接連溪洞升一等，若遷去溪洞諸蠻夷，別議定奪。

translations.literal: Incumbent Sichuan officials transferred to adjacent stream-cave regions — one grade promotion. If transferred to stream-cave regions of various Man and Yi peoples, separate deliberation and determination.
translations.idiomatic: Incumbent Sichuan officials moved to adjacent stream-cave districts received one grade; transfers into the stream-cave lands of various Man and Yi peoples were decided separately.

sentences.zh: 達魯花赤就彼處無軍蒙古軍官內選擬，不為常例。

translations.literal: Darughachi are selected from Mongol military officers without military forces at that place — not a regular precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Darughachi were chosen from Mongol military officers stationed where no regular army was posted — an exceptional practice, not a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 」二十二年，江淮官員遷於龍南、安遠縣地分者，擬升三等，仍以三十月為滿升轉。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-second year, Jiang-Huai officials transferred to the districts of Longnan and Anyuan counties are proposed for three-grade promotion, still with thirty months as the term for full promotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: " In that same year, Jiang-Huai officials transferred to Longnan and Anyuan counties were proposed for a three-grade promotion, with thirty months still counted as a full term for promotion and transfer.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，詔：「腹裏官員遷去雲南近裏城邑，擬升二等，若極邊重地，更升一等。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, an edict: "Officials from the interior transferred to near interior towns of Yunnan are proposed for two-grade promotion; if to extremely border strategic regions, one additional grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, an edict proposed that interior officials posted to Yunnan's nearer towns receive two grades of promotion, and those sent to the most strategically critical borderlands receive one grade more.

sentences.zh: 行省咨保人員，比依定奪。

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat personnel recommended by consultation are determined by comparison with these rules.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates recommended by the Branch Secretariat were judged by comparison with these rules.

sentences.zh: 其蒙古、土人及招附百姓有功之人，不拘此例。

translations.literal: Mongols, native peoples, and those among recruited and attached commoners who have merit — not bound by this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols, local peoples, and meritorious persons among recruited and pacified commoners were not bound by these rules.

sentences.zh: 」省臣奏準：「福建、兩廣官員多闕，都省差人與彼處行省、行臺官，一同以本土周回相應人員委用。

translations.literal: " Provincial ministers memorialized and received approval: "Fujian and Two Guangs have many vacancies. The central secretariat dispatches persons together with the Branch Secretariat and Branch Censorate officials there to jointly appoint suitable personnel from the surrounding native population.
translations.idiomatic: " Provincial ministers obtained approval to note that Fujian and the Two Guangs had many unfilled posts. The central secretariat would send representatives to work with the local Branch Secretariat and Branch Censorate in appointing suitable men drawn from the surrounding native population.

sentences.zh: 」部議：「雲南六品以下任滿官員，依御史臺所擬，選資品相應人，擬定名闕，具歷仕腳色，咨省奏準，敕牒到日，許令之任。

translations.literal: " The ministry deliberated: "For Yunnan officials of sixth rank and below whose terms are complete, according to the censorate's proposal, select persons of matching qualifications, designate named vacancies, submit service records, consult the province for memorial approval; when the imperial commission arrives, they are permitted to take office.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry ruled that for Yunnan officials of sixth rank and below whose terms had expired, qualified successors would be chosen as the censorate proposed, named vacancies filled, service records submitted, and the province consulted for memorial approval; only when the imperial commission arrived could they take office.

sentences.zh: 若有急闕，依上選取，權令之任，歷過月日，依上準理。

translations.literal: If there are urgent vacancies, select as above and provisionally order them to office; elapsed months and days are adjusted according to the above.
translations.idiomatic: If a vacancy was urgent, the same selection procedure applied and the appointee could take office provisionally; elapsed time would be credited according to the rules above.

sentences.zh: 」二十九年，詔：「福建、兩廣官員歷兩任滿者，遷於接連去處，一任滿日，歷江南一任，許入腹裏通行遷轉，願於兩廣、福建者聽，依例升等。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-ninth year, an edict: "Fujian and Two Guangs officials who have completed two full terms, when transferred to adjacent regions and upon completing one full term, after serving one term in Jiangnan are permitted general transfer into the interior; those who wish to remain in the Two Guangs and Fujian are allowed, with grade promotion per rule.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-ninth year, an edict allowed Fujian and Two Guangs officials who had completed two full terms in those regions, then one term in an adjacent area, and then one term in Jiangnan, to transfer freely into the interior; those who preferred to remain in the Two Guangs or Fujian might do so, with promotion by rule.

sentences.zh: 」至治元年，省臣奏：「江浙、江西、湖廣、四川、雲南五處行省所轄邊遠地分官員，三年一次差人與行省、行臺官一同遷調。

translations.literal: " In the first year of Zhizhi, provincial ministers memorialized: "Officials in distant districts under the five Branch Secretariats of Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan — once every three years dispatch persons together with Branch Secretariat and Branch Censorate officials for joint transfer and reassignment.
translations.idiomatic: " In the first year of the Zhizhi era, provincial ministers reported that officials in remote districts under the Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan Branch Secretariats should be transferred jointly every three years by envoys working with the Branch Secretariat and Branch Censorate.

sentences.zh: 」泰定四年，部擬：「諸職官子孫承蔭，已有元定蔭敘地方通例，別難議擬，如願於廣海蔭敘者，聽其所請，依例升等遷敘。

translations.literal: " In the fourth year of Taiding, the ministry proposed: "For all office-holding officials' descendants inheriting privilege, there are already Yuan-determined general rules on places of privilege appointment — separately difficult to deliberate further. If they wish privilege appointment in the Guang-Hai region, grant their request with grade promotion and transfer per rule.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth year of the Taiding era, the ministry noted that general Yuan rules already fixed the regions in which privilege appointment might be granted, leaving little room for further debate. If an heir wished privilege appointment in the Guang-Hai region, his request was to be granted with promotion and transfer according to rule.

sentences.zh: 其已咨到都省，應合本省地分蔭敘而未受除者，依例咨行省，令差去遷調官就便銓註。

translations.literal: Those who have already submitted consultation to the central secretariat and should receive privilege appointment within their own province but have not yet received appointment — per rule consult the Branch Secretariat and have the dispatched transfer officer perform examination and appointment on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Those whose privilege cases had already reached the central secretariat but who had not yet received appointment within their home province were, by rule, referred to the Branch Secretariat so that the dispatched transfer officer could examine and appoint them locally.

sentences.zh: 廣海闕官，於任滿得代，有由應得路府州縣儒學教授、學正、山長內願充者，借註正九品以下名闕，任回，止理本等月日。

translations.literal: For Guang-Hai vacancies, among those whose terms are complete and ready for replacement, if there are professors, Rectors, or Mountain Chiefs of route, prefecture, district, and county Confucian schools who wish to fill them — provisionally register them in named vacancies below regular ninth rank; upon returning from office, only their original grade months and days are counted.
translations.idiomatic: For vacancies in Guang-Hai, professors, Rectors, or Mountain Chiefs of route, prefecture, district, or county Confucian schools who had completed their terms and wished to fill them could be provisionally registered in named posts below regular ninth rank; on return, only service at their original grade would be credited.

sentences.zh: 廣海應設巡檢，於本省應得常選上等錢谷官選擬，權設，理本等月日。

translations.literal: For Guang-Hai patrol inspector posts that should be established — select from eligible upper-grade revenue and grain officials of the province, provisionally establish, counting original grade months and days.
translations.idiomatic: Needed patrol inspector posts in Guang-Hai were to be filled provisionally from eligible upper-grade revenue and grain officials of the province, with service credited at the official's original grade.

sentences.zh: 行省自用並不應之人，不許委用，如受敕巡檢到彼，即聽交代。」

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat self-selected and ineligible persons may not be appointed. If an imperially commissioned patrol inspector arrives there, handover is immediately permitted."
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat was forbidden to appoint its own favorites or unqualified men. When an imperially commissioned patrol inspector arrived, he was to be installed at once."

sentences.zh: 凡遷調循行：各省所轄路府州縣諸司，應合遷調官員，先盡急闕，次及滿任。

translations.literal: As for transfer and reassignment in order: among route, prefecture, district, and county offices and various agencies under each province's jurisdiction, officials due for transfer — urgent vacancies first, then completed terms.
translations.idiomatic: The order of transfer and reassignment within each province's routes, prefectures, districts, counties, and subordinate offices was: urgent vacancies first, then officials whose terms had expired.

sentences.zh: 急闕須憑各官在任解由、依驗月日、應得資品、及解由到行省月日，依次就便遷調。

translations.literal: Urgent vacancies require each official's in-service release certificate, verified months and days, qualifications due, and the month and day the release certificate reached the Branch Secretariat — in order, transfer on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Urgent vacancies were filled according to each official's release certificate from his current post, verified months of service, due qualifications, and the date that certificate reached the Branch Secretariat — in that order, and as locally convenient.

sentences.zh: 若有急闕，委無相應之人，或員闕不能相就者，於應敘職官內選用，驗合得資品上，雖有超越，不過一等。

translations.literal: If there is an urgent vacancy and truly no matching person, or vacancies cannot be matched, select from eligible appointed officials; verified against qualifications due, even if exceeding, not more than one grade.
translations.idiomatic: If an urgent vacancy had no suitable candidate, or posts could not be matched, an eligible official might be chosen even if he exceeded his due qualification by no more than one grade.

sentences.zh: 本管地面，若有遐荒煙瘴險惡重地，除土官外，依例公選銓註，其有超用人員，多者不過二等。

translations.literal: In administered territory, if there are remote, malarial, perilous strategic places — except native officials — public selection and examination per rule; for those over-appointed, at most two grades.
translations.idiomatic: In remote, malarial, or otherwise hazardous strategic districts — except for native officials — appointments were made by public selection and examination according to rule; over-appointment could not exceed two grades.

sentences.zh: 軍官、匠官、醫官、站官、各投下人等，例不轉入流品者，雖資品相應，不許銓註。

translations.literal: Military officials, crafts officials, medical officials, postal station officials, various fief household persons — by precedent not transferred into regular ranks — even if qualifications match, examination and appointment are not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Military officials, crafts officials, medical officials, postal station officials, and persons attached to various fiefs were by precedent barred from entering the regular ranks; even when qualifications matched, they could not be examined and appointed.

sentences.zh: 都省已除人員，例應到任，若有違限一年者，聽別行補註。

translations.literal: Personnel already appointed by the central secretariat should by rule take office; if they exceed the deadline by one year, another appointment may be made separately.
translations.idiomatic: Officials appointed by the central secretariat were expected to take office promptly; if they failed to do so within one year beyond the deadline, another candidate could be appointed in their place.

sentences.zh: 應有合就彼遷敘人員，如在前給由已咨都省聽除，未經遷註照會，不曾咨到本省者，即聽就便開咨。

translations.literal: Personnel who should be transferred and appointed there — if previously given release and consulted with the central secretariat awaiting appointment, without transfer notice or consultation reaching the province — may immediately open consultation on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Officials due for local transfer and appointment who had already received release certificates and whose cases were pending at the central secretariat, but whose transfer notices had not yet reached the province, might immediately open consultation locally.

sentences.zh: 無解由人員，不許銓註。

translations.literal: Personnel without release certificates may not receive examination and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: No one lacking a release certificate could be examined and appointed.

sentences.zh: 諸犯贓經斷應敘人員，照例銓註。

translations.literal: All personnel convicted of embezzlement who should be appointed per completed judgment — examination and appointment per precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Officials convicted of embezzlement who remained eligible for appointment after judgment were examined and appointed according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 令譯史、奏差人等，須驗實歷月日已滿，方許銓註。

translations.literal: For clerks, interpreters, memorial envoys, etc., actual service months and days must be verified complete before examination and appointment is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks, interpreters, memorial envoys, and the like could be examined and appointed only after their full term of actual service had been verified.

sentences.zh: 邊遠重難去處，如委不可闕官，從差去官與本省官公同選註能幹人員，開具歷仕元由，並所註職名，擬咨都省，候回準明文，方許之任。

translations.literal: At remote, difficult, critical places, if truly indispensable to leave vacant — the dispatched officer together with provincial officials jointly select capable personnel, submit service origins and appointed office names, propose consultation to the central secretariat; only after approved reply may they take office.
translations.idiomatic: At remote and critically understaffed posts that could not safely be left empty, the dispatched officer and provincial officials jointly selected capable men, submitted their service records and proposed titles, and consulted the central secretariat; they could take office only after approval returned.

sentences.zh: 應遷調官員，三品、四品擬定咨呈，五品以下先行照會之任。

translations.literal: Officials due for transfer: third and fourth rank — propose and submit consultation first; fifth rank and below — provisional notice to take office first.
translations.idiomatic: Officials due for transfer of third or fourth rank required prior consultation and memorial; those of fifth rank and below might receive provisional notice to take office first.

sentences.zh: 凡文武散官：多采用金制，建官之初，散官例降職事二等。

translations.literal: As for civil and military honorific ranks: mostly adopting Jin dynasty practice; at the founding of offices, honorific ranks were by rule two grades below actual posts.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military honorific ranks largely followed Jin practice. When the Yuan first established its bureaucracy, honorific ranks were routinely set two grades below the actual post.

sentences.zh: 至元二十年，始升官職對品，九品無散官，謂之平頭敕。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Zhiyuan, official posts and ranks were first matched grade-for-grade. Ninth rank had no honorific rank — called "flat-headed edict."
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Zhiyuan, posts and honorific ranks were first matched grade for grade. Ninth-rank appointments carried no separate honorific rank and were known as "flat-headed edicts."

sentences.zh: 蒙古、色目，初授散官或降職事，再授職，雖不降，必俟官資合轉，然後升職。

translations.literal: Mongols and Semu: first appointment is honorific rank or rank below the post; on second appointment, even if not reduced, they must wait until official qualifications permit transfer before promotion.
translations.idiomatic: For Mongols and Semu, the first appointment was either an honorific rank or a grade below the post; on the second appointment, even without reduction, promotion waited until their qualifications permitted transfer.

sentences.zh: 漢人初授官，不及職，再授則降職授官。

translations.literal: Han Chinese on first appointment receive rank below the post; on second appointment, appointment at reduced post rank.
translations.idiomatic: Han Chinese on first appointment received a grade below the post; on the second they were appointed at a reduced post rank.

sentences.zh: 惟封贈蔭敘官職，各從一高，必歷官至二品，則官必從職，不復用理算法矣。

translations.literal: Only for ennobled, posthumously conferred, and privilege-appointed offices — each follows the higher one. Once having served to second rank, rank must follow post, and the calculation method is no longer used.
translations.idiomatic: Only for offices obtained through ennoblement, posthumous conferral, or privilege appointment did rank follow whichever was higher. Once an official reached second rank, rank and post had to align, and the calculation method no longer applied.

sentences.zh: 至治初，稍改之，尋復其舊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhizhi, this was slightly changed; soon the old practice was restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhizhi era this rule was briefly modified, but the old practice was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 此外月日不及者，惟歷繁劇得優，獲功賞則優，由內地入邊遠則優，憲臺舉廉能政跡則優，以選出使絕域則優，然亦各有其格也。

translations.literal: Beyond this, for insufficient months and days: only service in demanding posts earns preference; meritorious rewards earn preference; moving from interior to borderlands earns preference; censorate recommendation for incorrupt capability and administrative achievement earns preference; selection for missions to distant realms earns preference — yet each also has its regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Where service time fell short, preference could be earned only in specific cases: arduous posts, meritorious rewards, transfer from the interior to the borderlands, censorate recommendation for integrity and effective governance, or selection for missions to distant realms — each governed by its own regulations.

sentences.zh: 凡保舉職官：大德二年制：「各廉訪司所按治城邑內，有廉慎幹濟者，歲舉二人。

translations.literal: As for recommended office-holders: In the second year of Dade regulation: "Within each surveillance commission's administered cities and towns, two who are incorrupt, prudent, and capable shall be recommended annually.
translations.idiomatic: On the recommendation of office-holders: under the Dade second-year regulation, each surveillance commission was to recommend annually two incorrupt, careful, and effective officials from the cities and towns under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 」九年，詔：「臺、院、部五品以上官，各舉廉能識治體者三人，行省臺、宣慰司、廉訪司各舉五人。」

translations.literal: " In the ninth year, an edict: "Censorate, academy, and ministry officials of fifth rank and above — each recommend three who are incorrupt, capable, and understand governance; Branch Censorates, Pacification Commissions, and Surveillance Commissions — each recommend five."
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth year, an edict required censorate, academy, and ministry officials of fifth rank and above each to recommend three incorrupt and capable men who understood governance, and Branch Censorates, Pacification Commissions, and Surveillance Commissions each to recommend five."

sentences.zh: 凡翰林院、國子學官：大德七年議：「文翰師儒難同常調，翰林院宜選通經史、能文辭者，國子學宜選年高德邵、能文辭者，須求資格相應之人，不得預保布衣之士。

translations.literal: As for Hanlin Academy and National University officials: In the seventh year of Dade deliberation: "Literary scholars and Confucian teachers differ from regular transfer. The Hanlin Academy should select those versed in Classics and Histories who can compose literary prose. The National University should select those advanced in years and virtue who can compose literary prose. Qualifications must match — commoners in plain cloth may not be preemptively recommended.
translations.idiomatic: For Hanlin Academy and National University posts, a Dade seventh-year deliberation held that literary scholars and Confucian teachers could not be treated like ordinary transferred officials. The Hanlin Academy was to choose men versed in the Classics and Histories who could write well; the National University, men advanced in years and virtue who could write well. Candidates had to meet the proper qualifications — commoners in plain cloth could not be recommended in advance.

sentences.zh: 若果才德素著，必合不次超擢者，別行具聞。」

translations.literal: If talent and virtue are truly outstanding and extraordinary promotion is warranted, report separately in full."
translations.idiomatic: If a man's talent and virtue were truly exceptional and warranted extraordinary promotion, a separate full report was required."

sentences.zh: 凡遷官之法：從七以下屬吏部，正七以上屬中書，三品以上非有司所與奪，由中書取進止。

translations.literal: As for the method of official transfer: subordinate seventh rank and below belong to the Ministry of Personnel; regular seventh rank and above belong to the Central Secretariat; third rank and above are not for regular offices to grant or withhold — the Central Secretariat decides.
translations.idiomatic: The rules of transfer were these: subordinate seventh rank and below fell under the Ministry of Personnel; regular seventh rank and above under the Central Secretariat; third rank and above were not for ordinary offices to grant or deny — the Central Secretariat decided.

sentences.zh: 自六品至九品為敕授，則中書牒署之。

translations.literal: From sixth to ninth rank is edict appointment — the Central Secretariat issues and countersigns the document.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments from sixth through ninth rank were edict appointments, issued and countersigned by the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 自一品至五品為宣授，則以制命之。

translations.literal: From first to fifth rank is proclamation appointment — governed by imperial ordinance.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments from first through fifth rank were proclamation appointments, governed by imperial ordinance.

sentences.zh: 三品以下用金寶，二品以上用玉寶，有特旨者，則有告詞。

translations.literal: Below third rank use gold seals; second rank and above use jade seals. Where there is special imperial order, there is an announcement text.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments below third rank used gold seals; second rank and above used jade seals. Special imperial orders were accompanied by formal announcement texts.

sentences.zh: 其理算論月日，遷轉憑散官，內任以三十月為滿，外任以三歲為滿，錢谷典守以二歲為滿。

translations.literal: Its calculation of months and days: transfer relies on honorific rank — interior posts thirty months for completion, exterior posts three years, revenue and grain custody two years.
translations.idiomatic: In calculating service time, transfer depended on honorific rank: interior posts required thirty months, exterior posts three years, and revenue and grain posts two years.

sentences.zh: 而理考通以三十月為則。

translations.literal: And for comprehensive examination calculation, thirty months is the rule.
translations.idiomatic: For comprehensive performance review, thirty months was the standard term.

sentences.zh: 內任官率一考升一等，十五月進一階。

translations.literal: Interior officials generally advance one grade per examination, one step every fifteen months.
translations.idiomatic: Interior officials generally advanced one grade per review and one step every fifteen months.

sentences.zh: 京官率一考，視外任減一資。

translations.literal: Capital officials generally per examination — compared to exterior appointments, one qualification less.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials, by contrast, advanced one qualification less per review than their counterparts in exterior posts.

sentences.zh: 外任官或一考進一階，或兩考升一等，或三考升二等。

translations.literal: Exterior officials: some advance one step per examination, some rise one grade in two examinations, some rise two grades in three examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Officials in exterior posts might advance one step per review, rise one full grade in two reviews, or rise two grades in three reviews.

sentences.zh: 四品則內外考通理。

translations.literal: Fourth rank: interior and exterior examinations are calculated comprehensively.
translations.idiomatic: For fourth-rank officials, interior and exterior service reviews were calculated together.

sentences.zh: 此秋毫不可越。

translations.literal: In this, not even the slightest hair may be exceeded.
translations.idiomatic: Not even the slightest deviation from these rules was permitted.

sentences.zh: 然前任少，則後任足之，或前任多，則後任累之。

translations.literal: However, if the prior term is short, the next term makes it up; if the prior term is long, the next term carries it forward.
translations.idiomatic: If a prior term fell short, the next term made up the deficit; if a prior term exceeded the requirement, the surplus carried forward into the next term.

sentences.zh: 一考者及二十七月，兩考者及五十七月，三考者及八十一月以上，遇升則借升，而補以後任。

translations.literal: One examination requires twenty-seven months; two examinations fifty-seven months; three examinations eighty-one months or more. When promotion is due, advance by borrowing, and make up in later terms.
translations.idiomatic: One review required twenty-seven months, two reviews fifty-seven months, and three reviews eighty-one months or more. When promotion came due, an official could borrow advancement ahead of time and make it up in subsequent terms.

sentences.zh: 此又其權衡也。

translations.literal: This, too, is its balancing measure.
translations.idiomatic: This was another balancing mechanism in the system.

sentences.zh: 凡選用不拘常格：省參議、都司郎中、員外高第者，拜參預政事、六曹尚書、侍郎，及臺幕官、監察御史出為憲司官。

translations.literal: For all selection not bound by ordinary regulations: provincial counsellors, bureau directors and vice-directors of the highest rank are appointed Counsellor-participating-in-State-Affairs, ministers and vice-ministers of the Six Departments; censorate and secretariat staff and investigating censors are sent out as judicial circuit officials.
translations.idiomatic: Selection outside normal regulations allowed provincial counsellors and bureau directors and vice-directors of the highest standing to be appointed Counsellors Participating in State Affairs or ministers and vice-ministers of the Six Departments, while censorate and secretariat staff and investigating censors could be dispatched as judicial circuit officials.

sentences.zh: 外補官已制授，入朝或用敕除，朝跡秩視六品，外任或為長伯。

translations.literal: Exterior appointees already receive ordinance appointment; upon entering court they may receive edict appointment. Court career rank is treated as sixth rank; in exterior posts they may serve as chief or senior officials.
translations.idiomatic: Exterior appointees already held ordinance appointments; upon entering court they might receive edict appointments instead. Court career rank was treated as sixth rank, while in exterior posts they might serve as chief or senior officials.

sentences.zh: 在朝諸院由判官至使，寺監由丞至卿，館閣由屬官至學士，有遞升之法，用人重於用法如此。

translations.literal: Within court, various bureaus advance from vice-director to commissioner; temples and directorates from assistant to director; academies and libraries from clerk to academician — each has progressive promotion rules. Selection of personnel weighs more heavily than application of rules, thus.
translations.idiomatic: Within court, various bureaus had stepwise promotion from vice-director to commissioner, temples and directorates from assistant to director, and academies and libraries from clerk to academician — each with its own ladder of advancement. In such cases, selecting the right person mattered more than rigidly applying the regulations.

sentences.zh: 又覃官，或準實授，或普減資升等，或內升等，或外減資，或外減內不減，斯則恩數之不常有者，惟四品以下者有之。

translations.literal: Also grace promotion: sometimes counted as substantive appointment, sometimes universal reduction of qualification for rank advancement, sometimes interior promotion by grade, sometimes exterior reduction of qualification, sometimes exterior reduction without interior reduction — these are irregular beneficent measures, applicable only to fourth rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: There were also grace promotions: sometimes counted as substantive appointments, sometimes universal reductions in qualification requirements, sometimes interior advancement by grade, sometimes exterior qualification reductions, and sometimes exterior reductions without corresponding interior reductions. These irregular beneficent measures applied only to officials of fourth rank and below.

sentences.zh: 三品則遞進一階，至正議大夫而止。

translations.literal: Third rank advances one step in succession, up to Righteous Counsellor.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officials advanced one step in succession, up to the rank of Righteous Counsellor.

sentences.zh: 若夫勛臣世胄、侍中貴人，上命超遷，則不可以選格論。

translations.literal: As for meritorious ministers and noble descendants, favorites at court — when the throne orders extraordinary promotion, one cannot discuss it in terms of selection regulations.
translations.idiomatic: As for meritorious ministers, noble descendants, and favorites at court, when the throne ordered extraordinary promotion, normal selection regulations did not apply.

sentences.zh: 亦有傳敕中書，送部覆奏，或致繳奏者，斯則歷代以來封駁之良法也。

translations.literal: There are also cases where edicts are transmitted to the Secretariat, forwarded to the ministry for review and memorial, or returned with objections — this is the excellent method of review and rejection passed down through successive dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes edicts were transmitted to the Secretariat, forwarded to the ministry for review and memorial, or returned with objections — the excellent method of review and rejection inherited from earlier dynasties.

sentences.zh: 凡吏部月選：至元十九年議：「到部解由即行照勘，合得七品者呈省，從七以下本部註擬，其餘流外人員，不拘多寡，並以一月一次銓註。」

translations.literal: On monthly selection by the Ministry of Personnel: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, deliberation: "Upon arrival at the ministry, discharge certificates are immediately verified. Those qualified for seventh rank are submitted to the province; subordinate seventh rank and below are registered by this ministry. All other outsiders, regardless of number, are examined and registered once per month."
translations.idiomatic: On monthly selection by the Ministry of Personnel: In the nineteenth year of the Zhiyuan era, it was decided that discharge certificates would be verified immediately upon arrival at the ministry. Candidates qualified for seventh rank were submitted to the provincial office; those of subordinate seventh rank and below were registered by the ministry itself. All other outsiders, regardless of number, were examined and registered once per month.

sentences.zh: 凡官吏遷敘：至元十年，議：「舊以三十月遷轉太速，以六十月遷轉太遲。

translations.literal: On official transfer and promotion: In the tenth year of Zhiyuan, deliberation: "The old thirty-month transfer cycle is too fast; sixty months is too slow.
translations.idiomatic: On official transfer and promotion: In the tenth year of the Zhiyuan era, it was argued that the old thirty-month transfer cycle was too fast and sixty months too slow.

sentences.zh: 」二十八年，定隨朝以三十月為滿，在外以三周歲為滿，錢谷官以得代為滿，吏員以九十月日出職，職官轉補，與職官同。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-eighth year, fixed court-attendant service at thirty months for completion, exterior service at three full years, revenue and grain officials at completion of handover, clerks at ninety months for office entry; officials transferring between clerk posts are treated the same as regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, court-attendant service was fixed at thirty months, exterior service at three full years, revenue and grain officials at completion of handover, and clerks at ninety months for entry into ranked office. Officials transferring between clerk posts were treated the same as regular officials.

sentences.zh: 凡覃官：至大二年，詔：「內外官四品以下，普覃散官一等，服色、班次、封蔭皆憑散官。

translations.literal: On grace promotion: In the second year of Zhide, an edict: "Interior and exterior officials of fourth rank and below universally receive one grade of honorific rank; rank insignia, court precedence, and privilege appointment all depend on honorific rank.
translations.idiomatic: On grace promotion: In the second year of the Zhide era, an edict declared that interior and exterior officials of fourth rank and below would universally receive one grade of honorific rank, with rank insignia, court precedence, and privilege appointment all determined by honorific rank.

sentences.zh: 三品者遞進一階，至正三品上階而止。

translations.literal: Third rank officials advance one step in succession, up to the upper step of regular third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officials advanced one step in succession, up to the upper step of regular third rank.

sentences.zh: 其應入流品者，有出身吏員譯史等，考滿加散官一等。

translations.literal: Those who should enter the ranked service stream — clerks with formal credentials, translators, and the like — upon completing their term receive one grade of honorific rank.
translations.idiomatic: Those eligible to enter the ranked service stream — clerks with formal credentials, translators, and the like — received one grade of honorific rank upon completing their term.

sentences.zh: 」三年，蒙古儒學教授，一體普覃。

translations.literal: " In the third year, Mongol Confucian instructors were uniformly included in the grace promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Mongol Confucian instructors were uniformly included in the grace promotion.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔在任官員，普覃散官一等。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict: incumbent officials universally receive one grade of honorific rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, an edict granted all incumbent officials one grade of honorific rank.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，詔：「內外流官已帶覃官，準理實授。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding, an edict: "Interior and exterior ranked officials who already carry grace promotions shall have them counted as substantive appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Taiding era, an edict declared that interior and exterior ranked officials who already carried grace promotions would have them counted as substantive appointments.

sentences.zh: 所有軍官及其餘未覃人員，四品以下並覃散官一等，三品遞進一階，至三品上階止，服色、班次、封蔭，悉從一高。

translations.literal: All military officers and others not yet granted grace promotion: fourth rank and below all receive one grade of honorific rank; third rank advances one step, up to upper third rank; insignia, precedence, and privilege appointment all follow whichever is higher.
translations.idiomatic: All military officers and others not yet granted grace promotion received one grade of honorific rank if fourth rank or below; third-rank officials advanced one step, up to upper third rank. Rank insignia, court precedence, and privilege appointment all followed whichever rank was higher.

sentences.zh: 其有出身應入流品人等，如在恩例之前入役支俸者，考滿亦依上例覃授。

translations.literal: Those with formal credentials eligible for ranked service who entered duty and received salary before the grace measure, upon completing their term also receive grace promotion per the above rule.
translations.idiomatic: Those with formal credentials eligible for ranked service who had entered duty and received salary before the grace measure also received grace promotion upon completing their term, according to the same rule.

sentences.zh: 」二年，省議：「應覃人員，依例先理月日，後準實授，其正五品任回已歷一百三十五月者，九十月該升從四，余有四十五月，既循行舊例，覃官三品，擬合準理實授，月日未及者，依驗散官，止於四品內遷用，所有月日，任回，四品內通行理算。」

translations.literal: " In the second year, provincial deliberation: "For those eligible for grace promotion, months and days are calculated first according to rule, then counted as substantive appointment. One of regular fifth rank returning from a term who has served one hundred thirty-five months: at ninety months he should rise to subordinate fourth rank, with forty-five months remaining. Having followed the old rule, grace promotion to third rank is proposed to count as substantive appointment. Where months and days fall short, verify honorific rank and employ only within fourth rank; all months and days, upon return from term, are calculated comprehensively within fourth rank."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, the provincial office deliberated: for those eligible for grace promotion, service months were calculated first according to regulation, then counted as substantive appointment. A regular fifth-rank official returning from a term with one hundred thirty-five months of service should have risen to subordinate fourth rank at ninety months, leaving forty-five months remaining. Having followed the old rule, a grace promotion to third rank was proposed to count as substantive appointment. Where the required months had not yet been reached, honorific rank was verified and the official was employed only within fourth rank; all service months, upon return from term, were calculated comprehensively within fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 凡減資升等：大德九年，詔：「外任流官，升轉甚遲，但歷在外兩任，五品以下並減一資。

translations.literal: On reduced-qualification promotion: In the ninth year of Dade, an edict: "Exterior ranked officials are promoted very slowly; but after serving two exterior terms, fifth rank and below all receive one qualification reduction.
translations.idiomatic: On reduced-qualification promotion: In the ninth year of the Dade era, an edict declared that exterior ranked officials were promoted very slowly, but after serving two exterior terms, officials of fifth rank and below all received a one-step reduction in qualification requirements.

sentences.zh: 」部議：「外任五品以下職官，若歷過隨朝及在京倉庫官鹽鐵等職，曾經升等減資外，以後至大德九年格前，歷及在外兩任或一任、六十月之上者，並與優減，未及者不拘此格。

translations.literal: " The ministry deliberated: "Exterior officials of fifth rank and below who have previously served court-attendant posts and capital warehouse, salt, and iron posts, apart from cases already receiving promotion-grade qualification reduction, thereafter up to the regulations before the ninth year of Dade — if they have served two exterior terms or one term of sixty months or more, all receive preferential reduction; those who have not reached this are not bound by this regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated that exterior officials of fifth rank and below who had previously served as court attendants or in capital warehouse, salt, and iron posts — apart from cases already receiving promotion-grade qualification reductions — and who thereafter, up to the regulations before the ninth year of Dade, had served two exterior terms or one term of sixty months or more, would all receive preferential qualification reductions; those who had not reached this threshold were not bound by this regulation.

sentences.zh: 」至治二年，太常禮儀院臣奏：「皇帝親祭太廟，恩澤未加。

translations.literal: " In the second year of Zhizhi, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "The Emperor personally sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, yet grace benefits have not been granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhizhi era, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "The Emperor personally sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, yet no grace benefits had been granted.

sentences.zh: 」詔四品以下諸職官，不分內外，普減一資，有出身應入流品者，考滿任回，依上優減。

translations.literal: " An edict: all officials of fourth rank and below, regardless of interior or exterior service, universally receive one qualification reduction. Those with formal credentials eligible for ranked service, upon completing their term and returning, receive preferential reduction per the above.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted all officials of fourth rank and below, regardless of interior or exterior service, a universal one-step qualification reduction. Those with formal credentials eligible for ranked service, upon completing their term and returning, received preferential reduction according to the same rule.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年，詔：「以兵興，內外官吏供給繁勞，在京者升一等，至三品止，在外者減一資。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianli, an edict: "Because of military campaigns, interior and exterior officials have borne heavy supply burdens. Those in the capital advance one grade, up to third rank; those outside receive one qualification reduction."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Tianli era, an edict declared that because of military campaigns, interior and exterior officials had borne heavy supply burdens: those in the capital advanced one grade, up to third rank, while those outside received a one-step qualification reduction.

sentences.zh: 凡註官守闕：至元八年，議：「已除官員，無問月日遠近，許準守闕外，未奏未註者，許註六月滿闕，六月以上不得預註。

translations.literal: On registration and waiting for vacancies: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, deliberation: "For already appointed officials, regardless of how near or far the date, waiting for vacancy is permitted. For those not yet memorialized or registered, registration for a six-month full vacancy is permitted; beyond six months, advance registration is not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On registration and waiting for vacancies: In the eighth year of the Zhiyuan era, it was decided that already appointed officials, regardless of how near or far the date, were permitted to wait for a vacancy. Those not yet memorialized or registered could be registered for a six-month full vacancy; beyond six months, advance registration was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 」二十二年，詔：「員多闕少，守闕一年，年月滿者照闕註授，余無闕者令候一年。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-second year, an edict: "When candidates outnumber vacancies, waiting for vacancy is one year. When the year and month are complete, register according to the vacancy. If no vacancy remains, order them to wait one year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, an edict declared that when candidates outnumbered vacancies, the waiting period was one year. When the year was complete, officials were registered according to available vacancies; if no vacancy remained, they were ordered to wait another year.

sentences.zh: 」大德元年，以員多闕少，宜註二年。

translations.literal: " In the first year of Dade, because candidates outnumber vacancies, registration for two years is appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Dade era, because candidates outnumbered vacancies, the registration period was set at two years.

sentences.zh: 凡註官避籍：至元五年，議：「各路地裏闊遠，若更避路，恐員闕有所礙，止宜斟酌避籍銓選。」

translations.literal: On registration and avoidance of native place: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan, deliberation: "The circuits are vast in territory; if route avoidance is added, vacancies may be obstructed. It is appropriate only to weigh avoidance of native registration in selection."
translations.idiomatic: On registration and avoidance of native place: In the fifth year of the Zhiyuan era, it was decided that because the circuits were vast in territory, adding route avoidance might obstruct vacancies, and that only native-place avoidance should be weighed in selection.

sentences.zh: 凡除官照會：至元十年，議：「受除民官，若有守闕人員，當前官任滿，預期一月檢舉照會。

translations.literal: On notification for appointment: In the tenth year of Zhiyuan, deliberation: "For civil officials receiving appointment, if there are persons waiting for vacancy, one month before the incumbent's term ends, report and notify.
translations.idiomatic: On notification for appointment: In the tenth year of the Zhiyuan era, it was decided that for civil officials receiving appointment, if persons were waiting for the vacancy, notification should be sent one month before the incumbent's term ended.

sentences.zh: 錢谷官候見界官任滿，至日行下合屬照會。

translations.literal: Revenue and grain officials wait until the incumbent in the jurisdiction completes his term; on that day notification is sent down to the relevant office.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue and grain officials waited until the incumbent in the jurisdiction completed his term; on that day notification was sent to the relevant office.

sentences.zh: 」二十四年，議：「受除官員省劄到部照勘，急闕任滿者，比之滿期，預先一月照會。」

translations.literal: " In the twenty-fourth year, deliberation: "For appointed officials, when provincial documents arrive at the ministry for verification, for urgent vacancies where the incumbent's term ends, compared to the full term, notify one month in advance."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, it was decided that when provincial documents for appointed officials arrived at the ministry for verification, and the vacancy was urgent, notification should be sent one month before the incumbent's term ended.

sentences.zh: 凡赴任程限：大德八年，定赴任官在家裝束假限，二千里內三十日，三千里內四十日，遠不過五十日。

translations.literal: On travel deadlines for taking office: In the eighth year of Dade, fixed the leave for packing at home for officials proceeding to post: within two thousand li, thirty days; within three thousand li, forty days; distant posts not exceeding fifty days.
translations.idiomatic: On travel deadlines for taking office: In the eighth year of the Dade era, the leave granted at home for packing was fixed at thirty days for posts within two thousand li, forty days within three thousand li, and no more than fifty days for distant posts.

sentences.zh: 馬日行七十里，車日行四十里。

translations.literal: By horse, seventy li per day; by cart, forty li per day.
translations.idiomatic: By horse, seventy li per day; by cart, forty li per day.

sentences.zh: 乘驛者日兩驛，百里以上止一驛。

translations.literal: Those using post stations: two stations per day; beyond one hundred li, only one station.
translations.idiomatic: Those using post stations traveled two stations per day; for distances beyond one hundred li, only one station per day was counted.

sentences.zh: 舟行，上水日八十里，下水百二十里。

translations.literal: By boat: upstream eighty li per day, downstream one hundred twenty li per day.
translations.idiomatic: By boat, upstream travel was calculated at eighty li per day and downstream at one hundred twenty li per day.

sentences.zh: 職當急赴者，不拘此例。

translations.literal: Those whose duties require urgent arrival are not bound by this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Officials whose duties required urgent arrival were not bound by this rule.

sentences.zh: 違限百日外，依例作闕。

translations.literal: Beyond one hundred days in violation of the deadline, treat as vacancy according to rule.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond one hundred days in violation of the deadline, the appointment was treated as a vacancy according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 凡赴任公參：至元二年，定散府州縣赴任官，去上司百里之內者公參，百里之外者申到任月日，上司官不得非理勾擾，失誤公事。

translations.literal: On formal attendance upon taking office: In the second year of Zhiyuan, fixed that officials of subordinate prefectures, departments, and counties proceeding to post within one hundred li of their superior pay formal attendance; beyond one hundred li they report the month and day of arrival. Superior officials must not unreasonably summon and harass them, causing neglect of official business.
translations.idiomatic: On formal attendance upon taking office: In the second year of the Zhiyuan era, it was fixed that officials of subordinate prefectures, departments, and counties proceeding to post within one hundred li of their superior paid formal attendance; beyond one hundred li they reported the month and day of arrival. Superior officials were forbidden to summon and harass them unreasonably, causing neglect of official business.

sentences.zh: 凡官員給假：中統三年，省議：「職官在任病假及緣親病假滿百日，所在官司勘當申部作闕，仍就任所給據，期年後給由求敘，自願休閑者聽。

translations.literal: On leave for officials: In the third year of Zhongtong, provincial deliberation: "Officials on sick leave while in office and leave to care for sick relatives, when leave reaches one hundred days, the local office verifies and reports to the ministry to treat as vacancy, still issuing certification at the post. After one year, issue discharge certificate to seek reappointment; those who voluntarily retire are permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On leave for officials: In the third year of the Zhongtong era, the provincial office decided that officials on sick leave or leave to care for sick relatives, when leave reached one hundred days, would have the local office verify the case and report to the ministry to treat the post as vacant, while still issuing certification at the post. After one year, a discharge certificate would be issued for reappointment; those who voluntarily retired were permitted to do so.

sentences.zh: 」至元八年，省準：「在任因病求醫並告假侍親者，擬自離職住俸日為始，限一十二月後聽仕。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, provincial approval: "For those in office who seek medical treatment due to illness and request leave to attend relatives, calculate from the day of leaving post and stopping salary; after twelve months they may resume office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of the Zhiyuan era, provincial approval was granted: for those in office who sought medical treatment due to illness or requested leave to attend relatives, the period was calculated from the day of leaving post and stopping salary; after twelve months they might resume office.

sentences.zh: 其之任官果因病患事故，不能赴任，自受除日為始，限一十二月後聽仕。

translations.literal: For officials proceeding to post who truly cannot take office due to illness or accident, calculate from the day of receiving appointment; after twelve months they may resume office.
translations.idiomatic: Officials proceeding to post who truly could not take office due to illness or accident had the period calculated from the day of receiving appointment; after twelve months they might resume office.

sentences.zh: 」部擬：「凡外任官日久不行赴任，除行程並裝束假限外，違者計日斷罪。

translations.literal: " The ministry proposed: "For all exterior officials who long fail to proceed to post, apart from travel and packing leave limits, violators are punished day by day.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry proposed that exterior officials who long failed to proceed to post, apart from travel and packing leave limits, would be punished day by day for violations.

sentences.zh: 」二十七年，議：「祖父母、父母喪亡並遷葬者，許給假限，其限內俸鈔，擬合支給，違例不到，停俸定罪。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-seventh year, deliberation: "For death of grandparents or parents and relocation of burial, leave is permitted. Salary within the leave period should be paid; those who fail to return in violation of rule have salary stopped and are punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, it was decided that leave was permitted for the death of grandparents or parents and for relocation of burial. Salary within the leave period should be paid; those who failed to return in violation of the rule had their salary stopped and were punished.

sentences.zh: 」二十八年，部議：「官吏遠離鄉土，不幸患病，難議截日住俸，果有患病官吏，百日內給俸，百日外停俸作闕。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-eighth year, ministry deliberation: "Officials far from home who fall ill — it is difficult to fix a cutoff day for stopping salary. For officials who truly fall ill, salary is paid within one hundred days; beyond one hundred days salary is stopped and the post treated as vacant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, the ministry deliberated that officials far from home who fell ill presented difficulty in fixing a cutoff day for stopping salary. For officials who truly fell ill, salary was paid within one hundred days; beyond one hundred days salary was stopped and the post treated as vacant.

sentences.zh: 」大德元年，議：「雲南官員，如遇祖父母、父母喪葬，其家在中原者，並聽解任奔赴。

translations.literal: " In the first year of Dade, deliberation: "Yunnan officials who encounter funeral rites for grandparents or parents, if their families are in the Central Plains, are all permitted to resign and rush home.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Dade era, it was decided that Yunnan officials who encountered funeral rites for grandparents or parents, if their families were in the Central Plains, were all permitted to resign and rush home.

sentences.zh: 」二年，詔：「凡值喪，除蒙古、色目人員各從本俗外，管軍官並朝廷職不可曠者，不拘此例。

translations.literal: " In the second year, an edict: "For all mourning observances, apart from Mongols and persons of various colors each following their own customs, military commanders and court posts that cannot be left vacant are not bound by this rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, an edict declared that for all mourning observances, apart from Mongols and persons of various colors each following their own customs, military commanders and court posts that could not be left vacant were not bound by this rule.

sentences.zh: 」五年，樞密院臣議：「軍官宜限以六月，越限日以他人代之，期年後，授以他職。

translations.literal: " In the fifth year, officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs deliberated: "Military officers should be limited to six months; days beyond the limit are replaced by others. After one year, appoint them to other posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs deliberated that military officers should be limited to six months of mourning; days beyond the limit would be covered by a replacement. After one year, the officer would be appointed to another post.

sentences.zh: 」七年，議：「已除官員，若有病故及因事不能赴任者，即牒所在官司，否則親鄰主首，呈報上司，別行銓註。

translations.literal: " In the seventh year, deliberation: "For already appointed officials who die of illness or cannot take office due to circumstances, immediately notify the local office; otherwise neighbors and community heads report to the superior, and a separate selection and registration is made.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, it was decided that for already appointed officials who died of illness or could not take office due to circumstances, the local office should be notified immediately; otherwise neighbors and community heads would report to the superior, and a separate selection and registration would be made.

sentences.zh: 」八年，吏部言：「赴任官即將署事月日飛申，以憑標附，有犯贓事故，並仰申聞。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year, the Ministry of Personnel stated: "Officials taking office immediately report by express the month and day of assuming duties, for attachment to records. Cases of corruption or misconduct are also to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the Ministry of Personnel stated that officials taking office must immediately report by express the month and day of assuming duties, for attachment to records. Cases of corruption or misconduct were also to be reported.

sentences.zh: 」天歷二年，詔：「官吏丁憂，各依本俗，蒙古、色目仿效漢人者，不用。

translations.literal: " In the second year of Tianli, an edict: "Officials observing mourning each follow their own customs. Mongols and persons of various colors who imitate Han Chinese customs are not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Tianli era, an edict declared that officials observing mourning each followed their own customs. Mongols and persons of various colors who imitated Han Chinese customs were not required to do so.

sentences.zh: 」部議：「蒙古、色目人願丁父母憂者聽。」

translations.literal: " The ministry deliberated: "Mongols and persons of various colors who wish to observe mourning for parents are permitted."
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated that Mongols and persons of various colors who wished to observe mourning for their parents were permitted to do so.

sentences.zh: 凡官員便養：至大三年，詔：「銓選官員，父母衰老氣力單寒者，得就近遷除，尤為便益。

translations.literal: On convenient care for parents by officials: In the third year of Zhide, an edict: "For officials under selection, if parents are aged and frail with no one to support them, they may be transferred nearby — this is especially beneficial.
translations.idiomatic: On convenient care for parents: In the third year of the Zhide era, an edict declared that officials under selection whose parents were aged and frail with no one to support them might be transferred to nearby posts — an arrangement especially beneficial to all parties.

sentences.zh: 果有親年七十以上，別無以次侍丁，合從元籍官司保勘明白，斟酌定奪。」

translations.literal: If there truly are relatives aged seventy or above with no other attendant in succession, the original registration office should verify clearly by guarantee, and decide after weighing the circumstances."
translations.idiomatic: If there were truly relatives aged seventy or above with no other attendant available in succession, the original registration office should verify the case clearly by guarantee, and decide after weighing the circumstances.

sentences.zh: ○銓法下

translations.literal: ○ Within the Laws on Examination and Appointment, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: On the Laws Governing Examination and Appointment, Part Two
